motivating_context: User-suggested lever: cumulative volume delta (CVD) — actual taker buy/sell volume, a more precise aggressor-flow signal than OBV's close-direction proxy. order_block_continuation_scalp.order_block_features already computes CVD (used only by S17's divergence route so far); S18/S20 never used it. This protocol tests CVD in two different roles on S20 H1's exact entry/exit, otherwise unchanged.

hypotheses.entry: identical to S20 H1 EXCEPT the flow confirmation is CVD > its own EMA(9) (long) / CVD < its own EMA(9) (short), REPLACING the OBV check entirely
hypotheses.regime_structure_positioning: unchanged from S20 (4h EMA200 trend+slope, 1h ADX>=20, order-block displacement>=1.5xATR/volume>=1.2x avg, OI non-negative/non-positive over 8 bars)
hypotheses.exit: identical to S20 H1: breakeven+chandelier trailing activated at +1.5R, trail 2.5x ATR, 8.0R cap, 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.entry: identical to S20 H1 (OBV kept, unchanged) PLUS a bullish/bearish CVD-price divergence pivot (backend/l1_filter/scalp_strategy.py::divergence_events, the same causal pivot detector already used and tested by S7/S17 for RSI) must have fired within the touch bar or either of the previous two bars

single_variable_isolated: H1 changes only the flow-confirmation source (CVD instead of OBV) versus S20 H1 — nothing else. H2 adds exactly one further required condition (CVD divergence) on top of S20 H1's unchanged OBV-gated base — nothing else changes.

symbols.note: Reuses the exact same cached klines/funding/metrics archives already downloaded for S18/S20 — no new data source.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2. No parameter grid over the CVD EMA span (fixed at 9, matching S20's OBV EMA span for a fair like-for-like comparison) or divergence pivot width/separation (fixed at scalp_strategy.divergence_events' existing defaults). A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink.
known_limitations: Same order-block, OI, ATR-freeze and no-order-book-reconstruction simplifications as S18/S20.
This is a retrospective diagnostic; not a live paper-forward result.
